entity.headline: About mmoving.de
entity.body: mmoving.de is the shared presence of three brands serving Munich and the surrounding area: SuperUmzug for moving, Entrümpelung München for clearance and house clearances, and BayReno for renovation and refurbishment. All three work under one coordination — one contact, one schedule, one contract, even when two or three trades come together. Active in Munich and within roughly 50 km, operating since 2004 with over 1,000 completed moves. Advice available in German, English, Slovak, Czech, Polish, Ukrainian and Croatian.

lead: The mmoving.de full service combines moving, clearance and renovation into one job with a fixed sequence, one point of contact and one fixed price. Booking the three trades together typically saves 20 to 35 % against three separate jobs — mainly because travel, setup time and coordination are only incurred once, which means significantly fewer work-hours overall.

sequence.headline: The sequence that works
sequence.intro: Each trade builds on the previous one. Reverse the order and you pay twice — for example when freshly laid flooring is damaged during the clear-out.

steps.title: 1. Moving
steps.body: Your belongings go to the new home first. That way you decide while unpacking what really stays — and what turns out not to fit.

steps.title: 2. Clearance
steps.body: We then clear the old flat completely, including the furniture that found no space in the new one. Sorted by material, with disposal documentation.

steps.title: 3. Renovation
steps.body: Painting, flooring and repairs follow in the empty rooms. Empty rooms are 15 to 30 % cheaper than furnished ones, because covering and furniture moving fall away.

steps.title: 4. Handover
steps.body: Final cleaning, a joint walkthrough with the landlord and a documented handover protocol — so the deposit comes back in full.

faq.headline: Frequently asked questions about the full service

items.question: Can I combine moving, clearance and renovation?
items.answer: Yes — that is exactly what the full service is for. All three trades run as one job with a fixed sequence, one contact and one fixed price, instead of three firms waiting on each other.

items.question: How much do I save with a combined job?
items.answer: Typically 20 to 35 % against three separate bookings. For a three-room flat in Munich that quickly amounts to over €1,000 — mainly because travel, setup time and coordination are only incurred once, which means noticeably fewer work-hours.

items.question: In what order are the services carried out?
items.answer: The move first, then the clearance of the old flat, then the renovation in the empty rooms, and finally cleaning and handover. This order is the cheapest, because work in empty rooms costs 15 to 30 % less.

items.question: How long does a combined job take?
items.answer: For a three-room flat allow one to two days for the move and clearance, plus one to three weeks for the renovation depending on scope. We fix the overall schedule after the survey.

items.question: Do I get a fixed price for all three services?
items.answer: Yes. After surveying both properties you receive a written quote with one total fixed price and a breakdown by trade — with no follow-up charges.

items.question: What happens if one trade is delayed?
items.answer: We shift the schedule internally. That is the advantage over three separate firms: no waiting time billed to you, and no blame passed between providers.

items.question: Can I book only two of the three services?
items.answer: Yes. The most common combination is moving plus clearance. Clearance plus renovation — typical for landlords after a tenant change — is also a package in its own right.

items.question: Is the full service available to landlords and property managers?
items.answer: Yes, that is package 3. For recurring work we offer fixed partner rates and priority scheduling, because vacancy time is the real cost driver here. Details on our B2B page.
